questions.evidence:
COSTUME CUPBOARD: Students may borrow a costume for a school performance with a teacher's signature. Each set has a coat, a hat, and a fabric belt. Check all three pieces at pickup and tell the cupboard volunteer immediately if anything is missing.

Borrowed sets must return by four on the school day after the performance. Do not wash them at home. Some fabrics need special treatment, so the school arranges cleaning. Place any damp piece in a separate open bag and tell the volunteer about it.

The borrower receives a numbered checklist. Keep it until the complete set has been checked back in. A teacher's signature allows borrowing, but it does not replace the final item check. Unreturned pieces remain listed under the borrower's name.

For fittings, visit the cupboard during Wednesday lunch. Fittings do not reserve costumes. A reservation becomes official only when the signed form is accepted. If two students want the same set, the first completed reservation has priority.
questions.explanation: 借出需同意，歸還仍要逐件核對。
options: Giving costumes away after performances.
Treating a teacher's signature as proof of return.
Documenting both permission and the complete borrowed set.
Washing every fabric in the same way.
